name: rust-tests-for
about: A Rust integration test file (tests/model.rs) for your library that passes on it and catches at least min_killed of its mutants; mutants that don't compile don't count.
instructions: Return only the test file: `use task::*;` then #[test] functions. Test the edges: boundaries, empty input, both sides of every condition.

code.about: the library to test, correct as it is

min_killed.about: share of mutants the tests must catch (0..1); some mutants can't be caught by any input, so 1.0 is rarely right
